effective.basis: TCG release of OP03-EN016 (OTS Tournament Pack 3), the printing that introduces the current text

transitions.historical_text: When this card battles with a Warrior-Type monster, increase the ATK and DEF of this monster by 2000 points only during damage calculation.
transitions.modern_text: If this card battles a Warrior-Type monster, during damage calculation: This card gains 2000 ATK and DEF during that damage calculation only.
transitions.summary: Wording modernisation only. The goat script is behaviourally identical to the modern one — the sole diff is `RESET_PHASE+PHASE_DAMAGE_CAL` vs `RESET_PHASE|PHASE_DAMAGE_CAL`, the same bits — and every English revision from v0 (WC4-002) to v5 (OP03-EN016) keeps the same mandatory EVENT_PRE_DAMAGE_CALCULATE trigger granting +2000 ATK and DEF for that damage calculation only when this card battles a Warrior-Type monster.

review.notes: Two non-adjacent upstream codes implement this card, which is the duplication oddity the instructions ask to flag. goat 504700139 carries lineage v0 (WC4-002, 2004-02-10), the text in force at the 2005-04 GOAT snapshot, and I picked it as baseline; pre-errata 511006006 carries text byte-identical to the pinned modern text (lineage v5) and a script differing from modern only by the string-id namespace and the same +/| constant, so it implements no distinct historical version and is unused. Intermediate cosmetic revisions v1 (CP04-EN010, 2007-09-06), v2/v4 (SDMM-EN010, 2010-02-19 / Machine Madness Value Box 2014-02-28) and v3 (TU06-EN013, 2011-08-04) are collapsed into the single cosmetic entry; v2's wording is what stood at the 2010-03 Edison snapshot and is behaviourally the same.
